title: Spicy Ukrainian Pork Skewers
description: Inspired by Mexican flavors, this dish combines the boldness of Ukrainian spices with the excitement of skewers. Perfect for a summer BBQ.

ingredients.name: Ukrainian-style spice blend (caraway seeds, coriander, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder)

instructions: In a bowl, mix together pork, Ukrainian-style spice blend, lime juice, and olive oil. Let it marinate for 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated pork, onion, bell pepper, zucchini, and tomato onto skewers, leaving some space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Sprinkle with Mexican oregano and salt. Serve hot.
